1965: /** Full artifact and replay row law is independent of the raw Worker acknowledgment. */
1966: function assertWorksiteCommandVectors(
1967:   task: WorksiteExecutionTask,
1968:   commandResults: readonly WorksiteCommandResult[],
1969:   predicateObservations: readonly WorksitePredicateObservation[],
1970: ): void {
1971:   if (!isWorksiteExecutionTask(task) ||
1972:     !Array.isArray(commandResults) || !commandResults.every(isCommandResult) ||
1973:     !Array.isArray(predicateObservations) || !predicateObservations.every(isPredicateObservation) ||
1974:     commandResults.length !== task.commands.length ||
1975:     !commandResults.every((result, ordinal) => {
1976:       const declared = task.commands[ordinal];
1977:       return declared !== undefined && result.ordinal === ordinal &&
1978:         result.commandId === declared.commandId && result.executable === declared.executable &&
1979:         same(result.args, declared.args) && result.relativeCwd === declared.relativeCwd &&
1980:         same(result.environment, declared.environment) && result.timeoutMs === declared.timeoutMs &&
1981:         result.terminationGraceMs === declared.terminationGraceMs &&
1982:         result.reports.length === declared.expectedReports.length &&
1983:         result.reports.every((report, reportOrdinal) => {
1984:           const expected = declared.expectedReports[reportOrdinal];
1985:           return expected !== undefined && report.ordinal === reportOrdinal &&
1986:             report.commandOrdinal === declared.ordinal && report.commandId === declared.commandId &&
1987:             report.expectedReportIdentity === expected.reportIdentity &&
1988:             report.relativePath === expected.relativePath;
1989:         });
1990:     }) || predicateObservations.length !== task.outcomePredicates.length ||
1991:     !predicateObservations.every((observation, ordinal) => {
1992:       const declared = task.outcomePredicates[ordinal];
1993:       return declared !== undefined && observation.ordinal === ordinal &&
1994:         observation.predicateId === declared.predicateId &&
1995:         observation.predicateKind === declared.predicateKind;
1996:     })) {
1997:     throw new TypeError("worksite command execution rows must preserve exact command, report, and predicate identity/order");
1998:   }
1999:   admitIJsonValue({ commandResults, predicateObservations }, "worksite command execution rows");
2000: }
